topics.title: Meaning and need of rural development

concepts.learning_objective: Explain what rural development covers and the key areas needing fresh initiatives.
Explain why agricultural growth slowed after 1991 and how it affects rural development.

topics.title: Rural credit and the banking system

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the multi-agency institutions of rural credit and the role of NABARD.
Explain how SHGs and micro-credit fill gaps in formal rural credit.
Evaluate the achievements and weaknesses of rural banking, including Jan-Dhan Yojana.
Describe the four government measures to improve agricultural marketing.
Identify emerging alternate marketing channels and assess contract farming.
Explain the two aspects of diversification and why it is needed.
Distinguish dynamic non-farm sub-sectors from those lacking infrastructure.
Describe the role of livestock and Operation Flood in rural livelihoods.

topics.title: Fisheries, horticulture and IT as livelihood options

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the structure and problems of the Indian fisheries sector.
Explain the contribution of horticulture to output, employment and livelihoods.
Assess the role of information technology in rural development and food security.
Explain the meaning and benefits of organic farming for sustainable development.
Evaluate the challenges in popularising organic farming in India.
